facts.fact: ITU's 2022 report says the Malian state telecom infrastructure company SMTD runs a government data centre offering colocation, integrated data centre, IaaS, SaaS and backup services to clients; the document does not say whether clients beyond government are served, and gives 2022 as its date.

systems.country_label: Centre de données de la SMTD
systems.owner: Société malienne de transmission et de diffusion (SMTD)

note: SMTD is being upgraded toward Uptime Tier III (not certified, so no tier3 fact); AGETIC hosts for the administration only, so no fact.
